Name: HuntHop
Author: Kat
Punchline: Faloop spawn alerts in chat, with a one-click world visit and teleport to the spawn through Lifestream.
Description: Receives Faloop spawn alerts from a browser userscript over localhost and posts them to chat with the spawn point as a map link and a [Go] link. [Go] (or Auto mode, when you are idle at a city aetheryte) world-visits through Lifestream, then teleports to the aetheryte nearest the spawn when the spawn point is known. Requires Lifestream.
